Anatomy, physiology, biomechanics, mobility, clinical evaluation, therapeutic exercise, and rehabilitation are all included in this entry-level professional degree.
a professional undergraduate degree that can involve advanced coursework, clinical instruction under supervision, and research components.

For candidates who have previously earned a relevant bachelor's degree, some Australian universities offer graduate-entry Doctor of Physiotherapy programs . These are not necessarily research doctorates; rather, they are professional entry-to-practice programs.

Graduate-entry or other postgraduate physiotherapy programs are offered by a few universities. There are several prerequisites for admission, and some programs call for a certain set of prior coursework.
Master of Public Health Master of Exercise Science

Those who want to work as physiotherapists in Australia must register as professionals.
Indian students should confirm the following before enrolling:
if the Australian Physiotherapy Council currently accredits the program.
whether the Physiotherapy Board of Australia has approved the program for the appropriate registration pathway.

Physiotherapy education is accredited by the Australian Physiotherapy Council. With administrative assistance from Ahpra, the Physiotherapy Board of Australia is in charge of professional regulation and registration criteria.
Career possibilities may include the following, depending on qualifications, registration, and experience:
Research positions in academia or universities following additional studies
Support roles for health programs and rehabilitation

While comparable research or support roles may have differing qualifications, certain positions need registration as a physiotherapist. Registration, experience, employer requirements, and open positions all play a role in employment.

faq.question: After completing their 12th grade education, are Indian students able to pursue physiotherapy in Australia?
faq.answer: Indeed. After Class 12, qualified students can apply to undergraduate physiotherapy programs , according to the academic, subject, and English language criteria of each university.

faq.question: In Australia, how long does physiotherapy take?
faq.answer: It typically takes four years to get an undergraduate degree in physiotherapy . The length of graduate-entry professional programs may vary.

faq.question: What is the price of studying physiotherapy in Australia?
faq.answer: For undergraduate programs, tuition can often range from AUD 40,000 to AUD 65,000 or more each year. Living expenses are extra, and fees differ depending on the institution.

faq.question: Is taking the IELTS required for physiotherapy in Australia?
faq.answer: Students must fulfilll the recognized English language criteria of the university. High minimum scores are required for several physiotherapy programs, and there is an additional English language requirement for professional registration.

faq.question: Does admission to physiotherapy in Australia need NEET?
faq.answer: For Australian physiotherapy programs, NEET is not always a prerequisite for admission. Verify the specific program's and university's prerequisites. 6.
